IMPORTANT: If the certificate holder is an ADDITIONAL INSURED, the policy(ies) must have ADDITIONAL INSURED provisions or be endorsed. If SUBROGATION IS WAIVED, subject to the terms and conditions of the policy, certain policies may require an endorsement. A statement on this certificate does not confer rights to the certificate holder in lieu of such endorsement(s).

COVERAGES

Insurer A. Commercial General Liability, occurrence form, policy 4GL-882014-06, effective January 1, 2026 to January 1, 2027. Each occurrence $1,000,000. Damage to rented premises $300,000. Medical expense $10,000. Personal and advertising injury $1,000,000. General aggregate $2,000,000. Products and completed operations aggregate $2,000,000. The general aggregate limit applies per project.

Insurer A. Automobile Liability, any auto, policy 4AU-882014-06, effective January 1, 2026 to January 1, 2027. Combined single limit $1,000,000 per accident.

Insurer B. Umbrella Liability, occurrence form, policy UMB-550913, effective January 1, 2026 to January 1, 2027. Each occurrence $5,000,000. Aggregate $5,000,000. Retention $10,000.

Insurer B. Workers Compensation and Employers Liability, policy WC-550914, effective January 1, 2026 to January 1, 2027. Statutory limits. Each accident $1,000,000. Disease, each employee $1,000,000. Disease, policy limit $1,000,000.

DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS

Re: Mechanical rough-in, Building C, Larkfield Commons, 88 Larkfield Road, Longmont, Colorado. Ellery Development Partners, LLC and Bramble Construction Group, Inc. are included as additional insureds with respect to the general liability and automobile liability policies where required by written contract, on a primary and non-contributory basis. A waiver of subrogation applies in favor of the additional insureds under the general liability, automobile liability, and workers compensation policies where required by written contract and permitted by law. Umbrella liability follows form over the underlying general liability, automobile liability, and employers liability policies.
